The White House Push to Reinstate Jensen Huang
 
Plus, the Pentagon is in talks with GM and Ford to make drones, and the most famous problem in math was just solved by AI—and a human
 
 
ANDREW HARNIK/GETTY IMAGES
 

1. FROM MY DESK

 

Jensen Huang is back as CEO of Nvidia after intense pressure from Silicon Valley, Wall Street investors and the White House.

 

The news, which came after Nvidia’s board had told investors Huang wouldn’t return, ended an 11-day exile following revelations of two affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset. This is an edition of The 10-Point newsletter, a guided tour of the best coverage in The Wall Street Journal. If you’re not subscribed, sign up here. If you’re reading this in your inbox, tap the headline above for online and audio versions of this newsletter.
